messages.content: Welcome to RockyCAD. Describe the 3D model you want to generate.

A 50mm long rectangular block with a horizontal 30mm cylindrical cutout resting along the top surface, acting as a cradle. Add two 5mm vertical rectangular slots through the base so I can secure the motor body with zip-ties, needed to be used as a motor mount, the motor will be stuck on the semi cylindrical wedge that will be formed
